item.title: Appreciation for Classical Music 🎻
item.author: saurav.dutta@enpc.fr (Saurav Dutta)
item.description:
Classical music expresses things in a subtle manner. It doesn’t try to fix grief or talk pain away. It just sits with them, and somehow, in its company, they become easier to carry. It has never made the heaviness disappear. What it does is quieter than that: it makes the heaviness feel less lonely.

And it asks for nothing, except that you listen to it. No argument, no answer expected. A few minutes of attention, and in return it hands back a feeling that you hadn’t found the words for yet.

item.title: Beyond Science: The Novel ✍️
item.author: saurav.dutta@enpc.fr (Saurav Dutta)
item.description:
The human experience cannot be fully captured by equations.

While engineering and research form the bedrock of my career, I have always believed that a person is not defined solely by their profession. True fulfillment lies in the duality of the analytical and the artistic, understanding the world through physics, and understanding oneself through narrative.

To that end, I am currently drafting my first novel. It is a work of fiction that blends memory with imagination, exploring the delicate tension between transformation and loss.

item.title: The Abstract & The Analog 🎨
item.author: saurav.dutta@enpc.fr (Saurav Dutta)
item.description:
When I step away from the rigors of engineering, I seek clarity in the abstract.

You will often find me engaging in dialectics on cosmology and orbital mechanics with fellow aerospace minds, or navigating the strategic complexities of the chessboard. It is a discipline of foresight and patience, a quiet war on 64 squares where I am perpetually refining my command of the game.

Musically, I find resonance in the melancholic. Whenever I am near a guitar, I instinctively return to the fretboard to test the endurance of muscle memory against a three-year hiatus. It is a tactile, analog escape, a necessary counterbalance to a life defined by scientific precision.
